items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 8:1
items.html: For the matter of refining bears only upon the detaining force and the limit that are in the screen out of the coarseness included in it, which comes to it because of the clash of the surrounding light against this detaining of its, which hinders the surrounding light that wishes to expand below the screen. And the matter of the clash of the surrounding light does not bear upon the vessels at all, for they in truth long for it; rather, it is the force of the screen that separates between them. (Chapter 2, Inner Light, Item 20)
